android.desc:
PocketMark is the editor for Markdown (.md) files you've been searching for all this time, it's feature include, but are not limited to:

📝 Find Your Files at a Glance: Markdown files are elegantly displayed in a dynamic grid, making it a breeze to manage your notes. Say goodbye to cluttered interfaces!

🎨 Sleek Minimalist Design, Maximum Impact: PocketMark has a sleek UI with delightful non-intrusive animations ensures a distraction-free writing experience maintaining yet eye-pleasing.

✏️ Smart Markdown Editor: Enjoy real-time syntax highlighting as you write, making writing .md files much more enjoyable.

📖​ Full Markdown Syntax Support: PocketMark supports the full markdown catalog, you will have all the tools you need at your disposal.

📐 LaTeX Formula Support: Add and render LaTeX math formulas in your markdown files, ideal for students, scientists, and anyone working with equations.

🌐 Share with Ease: Need to send that note to someone? No problem! Choose from various formats like .md or even as image and impress your audience, file sharing has never been so easy.

📏 Spacious Editor Screen: PocketMark's .md editor will give you as much screen space as possible, with our dynamic toolbar you get all the pixels you want.

📷 Media Support: Quickly insert images, gifs, links, tables and whatever you want in your notes to express yourself

📚 Universal Text File Support: Open, read, and edit various text file formats beyond just Markdown. PocketMark can read and edit almost all type of text files.

✌️ Dual Note Editing: Edit two markdown notes simultaneously with a split screen view and multitask effortlessly. 

🚪 External files support: got a file from outside the app you would like to view or edit? PocketMark can open, read and edit files from other apps too.

📴 Offline Productivity: No internet? No problem! The app works offline, so you can write, edit, and create even when you’re off the grid.

📂​ Accessible Folder: PocketMark saves your files in a easy to access folder of your choice letting you import files easily or integrate with third-party software effortlessly if you want to. Keep your workflow smooth and efficient.

🌐 Multilingual Magic: PocketMark markdown editor is translated in multiple languages, we are inclusive!

🌙 Themes and Customization: Choose between dark and light themes and more customization settings to suit your preference and reduce eye strain. Write comfortably in any lighting condition.
